new.x: TB incidence fell by 21% between 2015 and 2024, while TB mortality fell by 28%.

new.x: WHO certified the South-East Asia Region (11 countries including India) polio-free on 27 March 2014.

new.x: Albert Sabin developed the oral polio vaccine; Jonas Salk developed the first, injected polio vaccine.
